title: Floral carpet (red ground)
notes: Floral carpet (red ground). late 18th / early 19th century, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1936. inv. no 834 (2-123) from the Evkaf Depot, Istanbul. 100 x 450 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 94.
